metadata.objective: Complete P2-00 and close every Delivery Phase 1 carry-forward obligation from Implementation Plan Milestone 1 before Phase 2 leaf delegation

reasons: P2-00 changes shared configuration, secret, runtime persistence, application lifecycle, frontend-serving, deployment, dependency, and CI seams that the execution playbook reserves for Main
The owner requested that all Phase 1 carry-forward obligations be resolved before later work

rejected_modes.reason: No remaining obligation is both disjoint and outside a shared or security-sensitive seam
Delegation would split tightly coupled foundation contracts before their production consumers and gates exist

current_state_evidence.observation: Technical Specification 0.1.0 is approved and requires locked Python/TypeScript workspaces, separate runtime storage, safe operations, and release gates
Delivery Phase 1 is verified with 56 tests and evaluator repairs, while the original worker delta guards remain failed and non-attributable
Environment secrets, runtime SQLite, safe logging, mocks, frontend workspace/serving, Docker/Compose, and CI remain explicit Milestone 1 carry-forward items
Python source/tests and uv.lock exist; package/pnpm workspace, apps/web, runtime modules, mock servers, Dockerfile, compose.yml, and GitHub workflows are absent

control_flow.failure_path: Invalid startup configuration must fail with redacted diagnostics before serving requests
Unavailable capabilities return stable safe setup/degraded errors with request IDs
Migration or integrity failure prevents readiness without mutating immutable index data

control_flow.symbol: Vite build and FastAPI static serving
control_flow.failure_path: Missing build assets leave API health behavior intact and never enable broad CORS

invariants.statement: Foundation closure preserves approved public contracts, complete v1 scope, and the recorded Phase 1 limitations
invariants.prohibited_behavior: Changing an endpoint, error code, environment variable contract, schema, permission, trust boundary, or reporting a failed delta guard as passed
invariants.counterexample: Run the foundation contract test against a Technical Specification copy whose status is Draft or a report that marks the MVP worker delta guard passed

invariants.statement: Deployment secrets load from one direct or file source, collide fail-closed, and never appear in public responses or diagnostics
invariants.prohibited_behavior: Choosing silently between direct and file values, reading unsafe secret files, or echoing secret canaries
invariants.counterexample: Set one secret and its _FILE form to distinct canaries and inspect the startup error, logs, and public status

invariants.statement: Mutable runtime SQLite is transactional, migration-versioned, and separate from immutable index data
invariants.prohibited_behavior: Writing runtime rows into index.sqlite, committing a partial migration, or storing raw IP/session/CSRF values
invariants.counterexample: Inject failure inside a migration transaction and reopen the database to inspect schema version and tables

invariants.statement: Structured diagnostics retain request/event/status/count information while excluding bodies, raw IPs, tokens, cookies, prompts, answers, files, and private URLs
invariants.prohibited_behavior: Serializing arbitrary mappings or exception strings containing secret/private canaries
invariants.counterexample: Log a nested event containing password, token, cookie, raw IP, prompt, answer, and private URL canaries and inspect the sink

invariants.statement: GitHub and provider mock servers expose deterministic contract scenarios without external network access or real credentials
invariants.prohibited_behavior: Calling a live provider/GitHub host, accepting arbitrary mutation paths, or embedding real secrets in fixtures
invariants.counterexample: Send an unknown GitHub mutation path and unsupported provider capability request to the in-process mock app

invariants.statement: The typed pnpm/Vite workspace builds reproducibly and FastAPI serves the built visitor shell under the same origin without weakening setup APIs
invariants.prohibited_behavior: A second package manager, unlocked dependencies, broad CORS, browser secrets, or semantic setup content available only in animation
invariants.counterexample: Build the web app from the lockfile, start the real FastAPI app with the output, and request both / and /api/public/status

invariants.statement: The production image/Compose contract is one non-root same-origin application with a persistent data volume, healthcheck, and no external database/vector service
invariants.prohibited_behavior: Root runtime, writable application source, latest-only image contract, published private model port, or undeclared database/vector dependency
invariants.counterexample: Render the Compose model and inspect the app user, mounts, healthcheck, ports, services, and read-only settings

invariants.statement: CI uses uv and pnpm locked workflows and runs the same lint, type, test, and production-build gates documented locally
invariants.prohibited_behavior: A second package manager, unlocked install, omitted Python/frontend gate, or unpinned broad-permission workflow
invariants.counterexample: Parse the CI workflow and remove one locked install or required check from an evaluator-local copy

invariants.statement: All verified Phase 1 configuration, evidence, RRF, chunking, i18n, and setup API behavior remains passing
invariants.prohibited_behavior: Foundation catch-up silently changes a frozen Phase 1 contract or omits its tests
invariants.counterexample: Run the complete pre-existing Phase 1 suite together with every new foundation test
